name: assess_batch_search
description: Find the target or select one visually grounded contextual clue from a camera sweep.

result.description: found means the requested target is definitively visible; candidate means the target is absent but one specific contextual clue justifies investigating a place; not_found means neither the target nor any useful contextual clue is visible.

confidence.description: Required only for candidate: confidence that the contextual clue is worth investigating.

candidate_image.description: For found, the image containing the target. For candidate, the image containing the contextual clue. Use none for not_found.

target_position.description: For found only, a normalized point touching the target in candidate_image, using exactly x and y. Use null for candidate and not_found.

contextual_clue.description: For candidate only, a concise description of the visible clue, where it is, and why moving toward it may reveal the target. Use null for found and not_found.

name: assess_frame_search
description: Find the target or identify one useful contextual clue in a single camera frame.

result.description: found means the requested target is definitively visible; candidate means the target is absent but a specific contextual clue is worth investigating; not_found means neither exists.

confidence.description: Required only for candidate: confidence that its contextual clue is worth investigating.

target_position.description: For found only, a normalized point touching the target, using exactly x and y. Use null otherwise.

contextual_clue.description: For candidate only, a concise description of the visible clue, its direction, and why it may lead to the target. Use null otherwise.

name: assess_approach_verification
description: Verify from a fresh robot-camera frame whether an approach goal actually reached its target.

result.description: Use reached only when the target is visibly present and clearly near the robot. Use too_far only when the target is identifiable and visibly still too far away. Use uncertain when visibility, perspective, or occlusion prevents a reliable judgment.

confidence.description: Confidence in the result from 0 to 1.

target_visible.description: Whether the requested target is identifiable in the frame.

occlusion.description: How much the target is occluded.

evidence.description: Brief visual evidence for the distance and occlusion judgment.

name: select_navigation_pose
description: Assess overall navigation progress from fresh map and camera evidence, then either choose one safe local pose or end with a reason.

decision.description: move selects another local waypoint; goal_reached confirms the complete query is satisfied; blocked means no listed pose can be chosen, including when evidence is insufficient.

pose_id.description: Exact candidate ID for decision=move. Numeric IDs are local translation poses, F-prefixed IDs are frontier goals, and R-prefixed IDs rotate in place. Use only an ID listed for the current snapshot. Use null for every terminal decision.

reason.description: Brief evidence for the choice, or why no pose is suitable.
